results.name: Safe JSON and YAML retain scalar values and nested arrays
InitVar body, stat_data wrapper and InitVar tags yield the same state
YAML aliases, anchors, tags, duplicate keys and multiple documents reject
Prototype paths, nonfinite values, root arrays and non-JSON data reject
Getters never execute and cyclic, oversized or too deeply nested state rejects
MVU UpdateVariable/Analysis/JSONPatch extraction preserves narrative
Case-insensitive tags, json_patch alias, JSON fences and standalone arrays work
Incomplete, nested, multiple and missing MVU blocks reject atomically
Malformed JSON, YAML patches, duplicate JSON keys and unsupported operations reject
The retired status full/delta protocol is not accepted as an MVU update
replace keeps null values and remove deletes keys separately
insert/add work for object fields, array indices and tail append
delta increments and decrements finite numbers without type coercion
move supports from/to, object fields and array indices
JSON Pointer escaping preserves literal slash, tilde, dots and brackets
Unsafe metadata paths, stat_data prefixes and invalid escapes reject
Out-of-bounds arrays, absent parents and absent replace targets reject
A late invalid operation never changes the original state or writes a partial result
Patches and inserted values are not mutated by later operations
Old command text is treated as data and is never executed
Empty JSONPatch is valid and bounded to 256 operations
Universal config copy/paste contains only stat_data and update rules
Only one universal config exists and there are no preset-management methods
Old preset settings are preserved as inactive backup without restoring selection
Prompt uses MVU blocks, stat_data and literal data without macro expansion
Saving the universal rules never resets existing state or history
Invalid universal config leaves saved config unchanged
Fresh chat is empty and reads never write defaults to metadata
New state stores stat_data and preserves unrelated chat metadata
Version 1 state from a missing preset remains readable without rewriting its bytes
First migrated write preserves the exact v1 document in its backup key
Failed migration save rolls back both state and newly created backup
A previous v1 backup is never replaced by another migration write
Changed metadata revisions and foreign chat archives reject without overwrite
Editing, deleting and swiping earlier messages invalidates dependent snapshots
Chat renames retain state and replacement of the chat array invalidates old scopes
History retains the latest 80 checkpoints
Inline MVU update makes no API call or transcript mutation
MVU delta uses the previous floor and repeated notifications settle once
No-change patches initialize the configured InitVar without invented values
Bad model operations retain prior state with no partially applied checkpoint
A new card or chat starts with no state and has the same fixed universal config
Background requests use the current stat_data and MVU-only output instructions
Only the explicitly selected secondary channel is used
Missing secondary channels never fall back to the main API
Chat switches and response edits discard delayed independent output
Changing universal rules while a request waits discards stale output
Cancellation waits for main transport completion and discards its result
Quiet generation never recursively triggers an independent state request
Completed replies settle once while stopped replies require manual review
Disabled, excluded and manual modes prevent automatic writes and clear injection
A second page and an environment without Web Locks remain read-only
Concurrent state writes are refused while a metadata save is pending
Manual stat_data wrappers never create a duplicated stat_data level
Legacy localStorage migration retains original bytes and fixed universal rules
